title: US consumer prices, household debt, and the cost-of-living squeeze
discussion_signal: The post translates price, debt, and sentiment statistics into household adaptations: trading down, delaying purchases, reducing restaurants and vacations, and using credit for expenses formerly paid from cash flow.
linked_research_question: How price and debt pressure changes household room, substitution, saving, borrowing, and willingness to give up discretionary life.
limits: Public post relays multiple sources that are not reanalyzed here
The language of household adaptation is not a representative behavior measure
LinkedIn audience and selection are unknown
